## Functions

### `GicInit` { #gicinit }

```c
void GicInit(VirtAddr gicd_base_addr, VirtAddr gicc_base_addr);
```

Brings up the GIC: group 0, priority 0xA0 and CPU 0 as target for every interrupt, then enables the distributor and the CPU interface with no priority masking.

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `gicd_base_addr` | in | Mapped distributor base. |
| `gicc_base_addr` | in | Mapped CPU interface base. |

### `GicV2ConfigureIrq` { #gicv2configureirq }

```c
void GicV2ConfigureIrq(Irq irq_id);
```

Makes a shared peripheral interrupt level-triggered and routes it to CPU 0.

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `irq_id` | in | Interrupt ID; IDs below 32 are left alone. |

### `GicV2UnmaskIrq` { #gicv2unmaskirq }

```c
void GicV2UnmaskIrq(Irq irq_id);
```

Enables an interrupt in the distributor.

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `irq_id` | in | Interrupt ID. |

### `GicV2MaskIrq` { #gicv2maskirq }

```c
void GicV2MaskIrq(Irq irq_id);
```

Disables an interrupt in the distributor.

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `irq_id` | in | Interrupt ID. |

### `GicV2SetPriority` { #gicv2setpriority }

```c
void GicV2SetPriority(Irq irq_id, uint8_t priority);
```

Sets an interrupt's priority.

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `irq_id` | in | Interrupt ID. |
| `priority` | in | Priority; lower values are more urgent. |

### `GicAcknowledge` { #gicacknowledge }

```c
uint32_t GicAcknowledge(void);
```

Acknowledges the highest-priority pending interrupt.

**Returns:** The IAR value; bits [9:0] are the interrupt ID, 1023 means spurious. Pass it to GicEnd().

### `GicEnd` { #gicend }

```c
void GicEnd(uint32_t iar);
```

Signals the end of an interrupt.

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `iar` | in | Value returned by GicAcknowledge(). |
